morphology.compounding_rule: Goidelic compound ([quality|feature|saint](stem) + element: Dun-derg, red-fort; Ard-mor, great-height) layered over Old Persian relation-compounds and construct via '-ahya' and the Ezafe (Arta-xshaca, truth-realm; Dida-[name], fort of; [name]-pura, city of): the capital Dunfarnah (the glory-fort), Dida-Conn (citadel of the Conn-house).
morphology.patronymic_form: the Goidelic ruling clan keeps the Mac- (son of) and O-/Ua- (descendant of) patronymic and the fine/cland kin-group; the Persian populace keep the filiation 'X-ahya puthra' (son of X) or compact 'X-puthra' and a house (vith-X) or office; the throne fuses both - a ri who also bears a vith- house-name and a satrapal seat.

patterns.dungeons_ruins: fallen apadana-halls, dead fire-temples, and sunken Celtic raths: 'the buried Apadana of Dida-[name]', 'the dead Atashana of [name]', 'the Cairn of the Conn-clan'
patterns.military_units: the ruiri's sluag (war-host) and the Persian-style cavalry guard: 'the Sluag of Zaralba', 'the Spada of Urlaspa', 'the Iron Marcaigh (the riders of the plateau)'
patterns.ships: the few river-barges and royal-road craft of a horse-and-cattle power: 'Pride of the Abann', 'Bearer of the Baji', 'Boat of Turvasa'
patterns.taverns: 'The [Adjective] [Noun]': 'The Golden Farnah', 'The Hound and Cup', 'The Cup of Truth (Arta-jam)'

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon - Celtic Goidelic reflexes PRIMARY (family_celtic theonym_set: Toran, Orlann, Gaian, Numan, Realtan, Eternan, Dolar, Nochtluan, Raithan), Old-Persian/axsatran variants SECONDARY (the axsatran shifted morphs: Turvasa, Urlaspa, Gayanta, Naumana, Riyata, Asturna), never real Celtic/Iranian/Zoroastrian gods. The cardinal Persian virtue ARTA (Truth/Right-order) and its opposite DRAUGA (the Lie) carry over as the court's moral vocabulary, fused with the Celtic warrior-oath and the geis (the binding vow); the breaking of a geis is the Celtic face of the Lie. Alignment per the standard lens (Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic): the Celtic warrior-oath and the Persian Arta tradition read Lawful-friendly, the horse-clans' ancestor-cult and the cattle-raid reads Neutral, the wild Chaotic powers of the hunt and the war-fire keep their cults. The realm is broadly TOLERANT in the Persian manner - the ruiri shelters the subject cults beneath the crown.

clergy_ladder.5: Sacart-mor (consecrated priest) / Magupati (chief magus of a fire-temple)
clergy_ladder.9: Sinnsear-drui (eldest druid) / Magupatan Magupat (chief of chief magi)

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the Chaotic powers, warded as the fomoraig (Celtic demon-brood) or the hosts of Drauga (the Persian Lie), keep their morphs + an epithet: Maraxus -> Maragan the War-Brand (Pers. Marakhsha the Burner-of-Cities); Vacidus -> Faicid the Unmaker (Pers. Vakida the Devouring-Void); Lusanto -> Losand the Hoard-Worm (Pers. Lusanta the Coin-Serpent).

holy_symbol_motifs.Gaian: the enduring mountain beneath the winged ring-disc (the farnah-glory)
holy_symbol_motifs.Orlann: an iron spear crossed with an oath-ring (the geis-ring)
holy_symbol_motifs.Toran: a rayed sun-wheel over a crossed sword and the upright Arta-measure

religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Nemed (Celtic sacred grove) or the Atashana (Persian fire-temple) of [power]: 'the Nemed of Toran', 'the Atashana of Turvasa'; the druids keep the grove and the magi keep the ever-burning fire (Atar) on the altar.
religion.saints_pattern: the sinnsir (the deified champions and forefathers of the ruling clan) and the honest dead and just kings of the Persian cities, kept as fravashi (fore-spirits) and honored at the cairn, the standing stone, and the fire-altar; 'the Fior-true [name]' (the righteous [name]).

Gaiandus.gloss: the enduring earth, cold, and mountain

Numeno.gloss: air, lightning, sky-wisdom, and the good-mind

Orlandus.gloss: iron, oath, war, and the cavalier

Realta.gloss: the mother, mercy, healing, the Lady of Waters

Tulrius.gloss: the sun, fire, light, and justice; the lamp of right-order

religion.the_one: Eternan (Celtic; Persian Asturna) - the distant Ancient One and Wise Lord Most High, upholder of Arta, honored not petitioned

worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: Venerates the Chaotic powers of the canon - Raithan of the red hunt, Maragan the war-brand - and names the Lawful powers, and Eternan, as the tyrant-gods to be defied.
worship_by_alignment.Lawful: venerates the Lawful powers - Eternan, Toran the just, Orlann of the sworn war, Realtan the merciful - upholding Arta (right-order) and naming the Chaotic powers the hosts of Drauga the Lie, warded as the fomoraig (the demon-brood); the warrior-oath, the geis, and the king's-word-as-bond bind alike
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: the ancestral war-dead (the deified champions of the ruling clan) honored as the sinnsir (the forefathers) and as fravashi (fore-spirits), and the land-spirits of the nemed-grove and the -pura; the great powers and Nochtluan of the moon invoked at the nemed and the fire-altar situationally; the cattle-raid and the saddle stand under no single power

titles._tiers_note: Goidelic clanhold ladder, ascending, with the Old-Persian satrapal substrate co-titles beneath. Toisech (clan-chief / leader) barony over a Toisecheacht; Flaith-criche (border-lord) march over a Crich (the border-march); Tigerna (lord) county; Flaith (noble-lord) duchy ruling over a Xshacapavanam (the Persian SATRAPY he holds as a war-fief); Ri-tuaithe (king of a tuath) principality over a Tuath (petty kingdom); Ruiri (over-king) kingdom over a Mor-tuath (great tuath) - the kingdom DISPLAY title is the approved foreign 'Shah' from the Persian substrate; Ard-ri (high king) empire over the Vispa-tuath (the 'all-the-tuatha', Gmc Persian Vispa- + Goid. tuath). The subject cities keep their Persian Xshacapavan (satrap) and Framatar (appointed governor) and Marzapana (march-warden) beneath the Goidelic crown. The brithem (judge), the fili/ollam (poet-sage), the gudja-druid and the Persian magu stand outside the ladder. Rank titles fuse the real Gaelic and Old-Persian registers (allowed).
titles.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH (or an approved commonly-known foreign term where set in 'ruler'). The *_native conlang forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.
titles.government: feudal (a Goidelic horse-clan aristocracy over the Persian satrapal heartland: the ruiri (over-king) and his flaith-kin in the saddle at the crown, the tigerna-lords and the Persian Xshacapavan-satraps over the -pura cities, the marcaigh-riders and the king's-warriors sworn to the war-host; the magi tend the fire and the scribal court endures beneath; the brithem-judge and the fili-poet stand outside the ladder)
titles.heir: Tanaiste (the second; the designated heir) / Mathishta (the greatest; crown prince)
